name: Broccoli Cheddar Quinoa Casserole

components.name: Broccoli Cheddar Quinoa Casserole

ingredients.name: Vegetable stock or water for quinoa
Extra virgin olive oil for broccoli

steps: Heat oven to 200 C. Rinse dry quinoa and cook in measured vegetable stock until grains open and liquid absorbs, about 15 minutes.
Toss raw broccoli with measured oil and roast on a tray for 12-15 minutes until bright and tender.
In a pan heat milk and whisk in flour until thickened; turn off heat and mix in cheese and Greek yogurt.
Combine cooked quinoa, roasted broccoli and cheese sauce in a large baking dish and distribute evenly.
Mix breadcrumbs, garlic and measured oil, scatter on the casserole and bake 15-20 minutes until crisp and bubbling.
Rest before dividing into six portions. Freeze casserole in single-serving containers, noting yogurt sauce may look slightly grainy on thawing.
